body_markdown:
BOTHELL, Wash. –


[Immunome, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fimmunome.com%2F&esheet=54633224&newsitemid=20261102578107&lan=en-US&anchor=Immunome%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=027738d024931a3e132acd528fd647ad) (Nasdaq: IMNM), a clinical-stage targeted oncology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies, today announced that its management will present at the Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference on November 10, 2026, at 9 a.m. EST.


Interested parties can access the live audio webcast of the presentation from the Investor Relations section of the company’s website at[www.immunome.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fimmunome.com%2F&esheet=54633224&newsitemid=20261102578107&lan=en-US&anchor=www.immunome.com&index=2&md5=a6ef45e051d1869052e57bf408cf5004) . The webcast replay will be available after the conclusion of the live presentation for approximately 30 days.


**About Immunome, Inc.**


Immunome is a clinical-stage targeted oncology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies. We are advancing an innovative portfolio of therapeutics, supported by a leadership team with deep experience in the design, development, and commercialization of cutting-edge therapies, including antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). Our pipeline includes varegacestat, an investigational, oral, once-daily gamma secretase inhibitor for which an NDA has been accepted by the U.S. FDA; IM-1021, a clinical-stage ROR1 ADC; IM-1617, a clinical-stage solid tumor ADC; IM-3050, a clinical-stage FAP-targeted radiotherapy; and IM-1340, an IND-cleared solid tumor ADC. We are also advancing a broad portfolio of early-stage ADCs pursuing undisclosed solid tumor targets. For more information, visit[www.immunome.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fimmunome.com%2F&esheet=54633224&newsitemid=20261102578107&lan=en-US&anchor=www.immunome.com&index=3&md5=4ef97291399d82c36b26320979941eed) .
